seo.title: Aesthetics & Wood Therapy
seo.description: Integrative aesthetics, beauty rituals and body wood therapy in Torre de Benagalbón. Custom facial, body and natural eye design care.

hero.text: Rituals that honor the cycles of your skin and the harmony of your body.
hero.imgAlt: Rituals of Integrative Aesthetics and Wood Therapy at Salón Pilar Palomares in Torre de Benagalbón, Rincón de la Victoria

intro.title: The Art of Holistic Care
intro.desc: At Pilar Palomares, we understand aesthetics not as an end, but as a health process. We do not seek to hide, but to reveal the beauty that flows from a balanced body and oxygenated skin. Our facial and body treatments fuse ancestral wood therapy with the biotechnology of Biopolar Water™.
intro.card1Desc: We respect your natural hydrolipidic barrier 100%.
intro.card2Desc: We stimulate the lymphatic and circulatory system.
intro.imgAlt: Organic facial care and natural aesthetic biotherapy at Salón Pilar Palomares

mirada.title: Eye Design
mirada.desc: We enhance your natural beauty through the customized study and design of eyebrows and eyelashes, sculpting a perfect frame for your look.
mirada.imgAlt: Eyebrow and eyelash design at Salón Pilar Palomares, Torre de Benagalbón (Málaga)

cejas.name: Eyebrow Design
cejas.desc: Morphological study and eyebrow design adapted to your features. Includes hair removal (wax or tweezers) and definition through eyebrow tinting or eyebrow coloring.

lifting.name: Lash Lift
lifting.desc: Elevation and curvature treatment of natural eyelashes from the root. Includes eyelash tinting to intensify their color, or individual eyelash coloring service.

extensiones.name: Extensions
extensiones.desc: Meticulous application of individual eyelashes. Its function is to increase the amount and density of the eyelashes to intensify the look and enlarge the eyes.

micropigmentacion.name: Micropigmentation
micropigmentacion.desc: Semi-permanent hair-by-hair eyebrow makeup technique. Fills in gaps, defines the shape and provides symmetry achieving a perfect, natural-looking frame.

depilacion.title: Waxing & Makeup
depilacion.desc: We offer essential hair removal and professional makeup services designed to pamper your skin and enhance the harmony of your natural features.
depilacion.depilacionDesc: Facial or body waxing. Service tailored for both women and men.
depilacion.maquillajeDesc: We enhance facial features and hide flaws to achieve greater harmony.
depilacion.imgAlt: Professional makeup at Salón Pilar Palomares, Torre de Benagalbón

sensitiva.name: Sensitive Biotherapy
sensitiva.desc: Calms and restores balance in reactive skin.

iluminante.name: Illuminating Biotherapy
iluminante.desc: Brings light and unifies tone by fighting spots.

antiaging.name: Anti-aging Biotherapy
antiaging.desc: Deep restructuring to smooth expression lines.

detox.name: Detox Biotherapy
detox.desc: Intense purification for oily or congested skin.

manosPies.title: Hands, Feet & Massage
manosPies.desc: Your limbs are the discharge points of your energy channels and your body accumulates everyday tension. Treating them with hand and foot biotherapies or body wellness massages drains, oxygenates and relaxes your body, providing absolute lightness and deep calm.

manos.label: Enhancement & Nutrition
manos.title: Hand Biotherapy
manos.desc: Complete manicure: this beautification treatment will help you care for hands and nails, exfoliating and nourishing the skin to treat alterations and restore its natural softness.
manos.imgAlt: Hand Biotherapy at Salón Pilar Palomares

pies.label: Lightness & Integral Care
pies.title: Foot Biotherapy
pies.desc: Complete pedicure: this comprehensive treatment will help you exfoliate feet and care for nails, eliminating hardnesses and keeping your skin free of imperfections.
pies.imgAlt: Foot Biotherapy at Salón Pilar Palomares

masajes.label: Disconnection & Deep Calm
masajes.title: Massages
masajes.desc: Body wellness: this treatment will help you relieve muscle tension, improve circulation and reduce stress, releasing accumulated tension in body and mind.
masajes.imgAlt: Relaxing body massage at Salón Pilar Palomares

madero.title: Wood Therapy
madero.quote: "The power of the noble wood material masterfully applied to channel energy and reshape your figure."
madero.desc: Wood therapy consists of the application of a massage using various wooden utensils, of different sizes and shapes, specially designed to adapt to the anatomy of the body. It helps to firm, tone and combat cellulite in a non-invasive way.
madero.corporalDesc: Deep modeling through wooden tools that stimulate the elimination of toxins and reduce volume. It can be combined with Sculptor biotherapy.
madero.imgAlt: Professional Wood Therapy session in Axarquía

cta.title: Treat Yourself to a Moment of Real Beauty
cta.desc: Feel free to ask us any questions. We are here to guide you towards your best version with treatments that respect your essence.
